published_needs_content.name: published_needs_content
published_needs_content.value: (status <> 'published'::core.report_status) OR ((content IS NOT NULL) AND (published_by IS NOT NULL))

safety_events_check.name: safety_events_check
safety_events_check.value: (session_id IS NOT NULL) OR (work_sample_id IS NOT NULL)

users_has_identifier.name: users_has_identifier
users_has_identifier.value: (email IS NOT NULL) OR (username IS NOT NULL)

student_interests_check.name: student_interests_check
student_interests_check.value: (interest_id IS NOT NULL) OR (free_text IS NOT NULL)

core.v_student_access.name: v_student_access
core.v_student_access.definition: SELECT ct.user_id, e.student_id, 'class'::text AS via FROM core.class_teachers ct JOIN core.class_enrollments e ON e.class_id = ct.class_id WHERE e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE UNION SELECT st.user_id, st.student_id, 'direct'::text AS via FROM core.student_teachers st WHERE st.end_date IS NULL OR st.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE

core.v_student_current_classes.name: v_student_current_classes
core.v_student_current_classes.definition: SELECT e.student_id, c.id AS class_id, c.name AS class_name, c.programme, c.branch_id, e.start_date FROM core.class_enrollments e JOIN core.classes c ON c.id = e.class_id WHERE e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE

core.v_current_levels.name: v_current_levels
core.v_current_levels.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON (student_id, kind, key) student_id, kind, key, subject_id, score, effective_from, set_by_observation_id, set_by_user_id FROM core.student_levels ORDER BY student_id, kind, key, effective_from DESC

core.v_current_consents.name: v_current_consents
core.v_current_consents.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON (student_id, consent_type) student_id, consent_type, status, method, granted_at, withdrawn_at, created_at FROM core.consents ORDER BY student_id, consent_type, created_at DESC
